# Building

Requirements: CMake ≥3.20, a C/C++ compiler with C99/C++17 support, threads, and Ninja or another CMake generator. The audited local lane used CMake 3.30.5, Ninja 1.12.1, and Zig 0.14.1's Clang 19.1.7 musl compiler. Scripts discover system tools or accept `TOOLCHAINS_ROOT`, `CMAKE`, `NINJA`, `CC`, `CXX`, and `ZIG_EXECUTABLE` overrides.

Key options:

| Option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---:|---|
| `IBAUDIO_BUILD_SHARED` | ON | shared C ABI library, SONAME 1 |
| `IBAUDIO_BUILD_CLI` | ON | CLI |
| `IBAUDIO_BUILD_TESTS` | ON | CTest suite |
| `IBAUDIO_ENABLE_VULKAN_PROBE` | OFF | loader/symbol probe only |
| `IBAUDIO_ENABLE_AUDIO_CPP_ADAPTER` | OFF | pristine-pin-gated empty adapter scaffold |
| `IBAUDIO_ENABLE_SANITIZERS` | OFF | ASan+UBSan |
| `IBAUDIO_WARNINGS_AS_ERRORS` | ON | strict first-party compile |
| `IBAUDIO_ENABLE_ELF_VERSION_SCRIPT` | OFF | GNU linker symbol labels; not supported by Zig ld |

`CMakePresets.json` includes Linux debug/release/sanitizer, Windows x64 Zig, native macOS universal, and Android arm64 CPU/Vulkan-probe configurations. The Windows x64 cross-build passed locally but was not executed; macOS/Android remain support scaffolds until their lanes generate evidence. Do not infer runtime support from a preset.

The default build never opens upstream audio.cpp. The optional scaffold requires `IBAUDIO_AUDIO_CPP_SOURCE_DIR`; configure verifies exact HEAD and clean status before compiling a source file that still includes no upstream header.

Install with `cmake --install`. Exported CMake target is `InBharat::ibaudio` as generated by the install export; build-tree alias is `InBharat::Audio`.
